description: 3 ops, scale=1.59e-4, revolve(circle,boss)+extrude(rectangle,boss)+extrude(circle,cut) — euler_target hand-corrected 2026-07-21 (was the naive 3-op default 2): the tilted cut tube (r=3.905e-5, axis ~36deg off the box normal) spans the box's cross-section mid-bands (half-widths 2.153e-5/3.755e-5 < r) but not its corners (4.33e-5 > r), so the cut leaves 4 corner pillars bridging the two remaining slabs: genus-3, chi=-4. Verified by Cherchi-2022 sidecar reference boolean on the exact Stage-1 operand meshes (chi=-4, 1 shell, fully paired) AND an independent voxel-CSG Euler derivation from the authored numbers (chi_solid=-2 -> boundary chi=-4, 1 component). The revolve sausage is a separate standalone body (disjoint bbox) not measured by the last-body euler oracle.
